title: Force import/use_multiple_threads = false on Recovery mode
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot  4.5 Beta 5, Tested on Linux, however, it still happened on godot 4.3 or 4.4 when multi-threaded import was added

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta5 - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce 940MX (nvidia; 575.64.05) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7500U CPU @ 2.70GHz (4 threads) - 7.62 GiB memory

### Issue description

On Dual-Core systems, i was not possible to open my big project, it would get suck on importing assets, thing that did not happened, and it would not happened on my six core computers.

But when i changed the editor property on the project file: use_multiple_threads = false

It was able to open recovery mode normally. and after importing the files again, it would open the project regardless of having use_multiple_threads activated or not.

So it's not necessarily a bug, but rather a small detail that went unnoticed, which is why I created this issue.

### Steps to reproduce

On dual core systems, importing large projects may get stuck.

I was only able to reproduce on my big project, and my project simply has to many diferent file types to really know, but it would usually get stuck on importing translation files an ogg files. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Please read steps to reproduce for info.
